selectionProtocol.market: linear USDT-quoted and USDT-settled perpetual swap
selectionProtocol.ranking: descending contemporaneous exchange-reported 24h quoteVolume; canonical symbol ascending lexical tie-break
eligibility: canonical symbol absent from every S1 train/validation/untouched-OOS series and S4 development/internal-holdout exclusions
selectionProtocol.postSelectionReplacement: forbidden; any acquisition/schema/completeness failure blocks with reveal=0

dataProtocol.barAlignment: timestamp must equal start + rowIndex*3600000; unique, strictly increasing, UTC epoch-aligned
dataProtocol.missingDataPolicy: zero missing/duplicate/off-grid/non-finite/invalid-OHLCV rows permitted; reject the entire frozen holdout and keep reveal=0; no symbol replacement or interpolation
dataProtocol.partialBars: excluded by endExclusive at the latest fully closed hourly boundary at snapshot time
